content_sections.heading: ICAR IISWC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ICAR IISWC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ICAR IISWC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow: Postgraduate degree in Soil and Water Conservation Engineering/Land and Water Resources Engineering/Irrigation and Drainage Engineering/Water Resources/Remote Sensing and Geographical Information System/Civil Engineering with specialization in Hydrology/Hydraulics and Water Resources Engineering + NET/GATE + 2 years research experience in RS & GIS/Hydrological modelling/Soil & Water Conservation Engineering. Young Professional-I: B.Tech/Bachelor of Engineering in Civil/Agricultural Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow: 35 years (Men) / 40 years (Women) Young Professional-I: 21-45 years with 5 years relaxation for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: Salary/ Stipend
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow: Rs. 42,000/- per month + HRA Young Professional-I: Rs. 30,000/- per month (Consolidated)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IISWC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IISWC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview, scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates should report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow and Young Professional-I posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with one post for Senior Research Fellow and one post for Young Professional-I.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: A postgraduate degree in relevant engineering fields with NET/GATE and 2 years of research experience in RS & GIS/Hydrological modelling/Soil & Water Conservation Engineering is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Young Professional-I post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the ICAR IISWC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Young Professional-I post is between 21 to 45 years, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at ICAR-Indian Institute of Soil & Water Conservation, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, Pin Code: 248195.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of ICAR-Indian Institute of Soil & Water Conservation?
faq.answer: The official website of ICAR-Indian Institute of Soil & Water Conservation is http://www.cswcrtiweb.org/.
